name: Pallet Spawner

palletsPerMinute.label: Feed rate
palletsPerMinute.desc: Pallets per minute. 0 halts the magazine without pausing the part.

fixedRate.label: Fixed rate (off = ±50% jitter)
fixedRate.desc: On, pallets arrive on an exact metronome. Off, each gap is randomised between half and one-and-a-half times the nominal period.

palletColor.label: Pallet color
palletColor.desc: Tint multiplied over the pallet wood model. Leave it white unless you want dispensed pallets to read differently from hand-placed ones beside them.

mass.label: Mass (kg)
mass.desc: Mass given to every dispensed pallet, before anything is stacked on it.

disable.label: Paused
disable.desc: Stop dispensing entirely. Use (C, or E while walking) is a separate hand stop: it pauses and resumes the magazine during a run without changing this setting, and is cleared when the run stops.

conveyorId.label: Pause when conveyor stopped
conveyorId.desc: Interlock: while the named conveyor is stopped, this spawner holds. Wire that conveyor to the PLC and the feed gates itself, with no tag of its own.

enableComms.label: Enable comms
enableComms.desc: Connect this part to a PLC program. Its tags appear once this is on.

runTag.label: Run tag (spawn only while true)
runTag.desc: Gate the magazine from the program. Note this only takes over once a program actually DRIVES the tag - until then the spawner keeps running, so a merely-declared tag is not a stopped feed.

countTag.label: Spawned count tag
countTag.desc: Running total of pallets this spawner has dispensed. Subtract the despawner counts to get the work in progress.
